notes.title: New cards, better enemy AI (v0.9)
notes.content:
[p]Version 0.9 brings couple new cards, buffs to weak keywords, enemy AI improvements and new sound effects. [i](Next update in October.) [/i]Feelment decided to approve some of my songs to their karaoke service, finally, after the whole summer basically. I will be able to sing them in the next student parties, so to celebrate that I fixed all the current bugs on v0.9 and will release it now two weeks early – yippee![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663986/5abe089347f921fea4a996caebb8a193d5af8b5e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][u]New Keywords[/u][/p][p][i]2 new keywords.[/i][/p][p]· Soul Robber – Permanently steal the cards this defeats. [i](Move powerful version of Soul Hunter, but more strategic in case you steal a bad card.)[/i][/p][p]· Victim – Winning and losing are reversed. [i](Interesting, counters guns and OP cards.)[/i][/p][p]
[/p][p][u]New cards[/u][/p][p][i]13 new cards.[/i][/p][p]· Lava Lamp [i](Zipper)[/i] – Digital, Cooties[/p][p]· Bone Fingers (Scissors) – Undead, Soul Hunter, Shadow-replace[/p][p]· Roulette [i](Paper[/i]) – Coin-flip[/p][p]· Die-Throw [i](Rock)[/i] – Coin-flip, Pair[/p][p]· Luv-Luv Slaver [i](Gun)[/i] – Soul Robber, Cooties[/p][p]· Speed Test [i](Scissor[/i]) – Coin-flip, Sinful[/p][p]· Fire Arrows [i](Scissor[/i]) – Incinerate, Reload[/p][p]· Drone [i](Gun[/i]) – High-ground, Pick-up[/p][p]· Invisibility Cloak [i](Paper[/i]) – Shadow-replace, Very Nutty[/p][p]· Rattlesnake [i](Scissor)[/i] – Victim[/p][p]· Legal Files [i](Paper)[/i] – Victim[/p][p]· Pearl [i](Rock)[/i] – Victim[/p][p]· Ticci Doll [i](Rockstar)[/i] – Dirt, Spy, Berserk[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663986/5f58bd6e544beb8f8d9a328d2bb23404cfb6ddca.png"][/img][/p][p][u]Logic Changes[/u][/p][p][i]Buffed weak keywords.[/i][/p][p]· Cooties has been changed. Now instead of defeating vanillas, it defeats cards with less keywords. [i](Previously cooties was one of the worst keywords in the game, and after first rounds it sees no play. This change keeps the original intention of the keyword, but makes it powerful. And in card design allows scaling with 2-keyword and 3-keyword cards. For example Girl’s Diary is not now just worse version of Love Letter, but Secrets is compensated by the fact that Cooties now affects all 1-keyword cards. Also with this update, updated art for Girl’s Diary and Eyelash Curlers, as the previous artwork had random anime girls. Now the new artworks try to present Anne-Lotte and Raisen in the back.)[/i][/p][p]· November now also resets opponents nut. [i](Meaning the turn counter towards their next nut goes to 0, and multiplier for their next nut goes to 1. November has been kinda useless keyword, as it is impossible to time it. Now you don’t have to time it perfectly.)[/i][/p][p]· If multi-type Chameleon/Werewolf gets changed to uni-type, next time it shifts, it will become a multi-type again. [i](Before it just remained uni-type forever – that sucks.)[/i][/p][p]· Changed Aura Farming limit from 10 → 3 cards of the same type played in a row. [i](With 10 Dorodango kinda sucks, cause in normal situations you can never draw it. But if the limit is 3, then it becomes a possible challenge and I can design more powerful cards around the mechanic.)[/i][/p][p]· If a card has a negative multiplier, it cannot gain points with Ocean Dweller or nutting. [i](Makes Dirt more impactful, and just makes sense.)[/i][/p][p]· Now when you reach the point goal, lives automatically reduce to 1. [i](Maybe later I will add some victory cut-scene or effect, and then it says – you are now on endless mode.)[/i][/p][p]
[/p][p][u]Enemy AI[/u][/p][p][i]Improvements to make the AI more hard, because game has gotten more complicated with all the advanced keywords.[/i][/p][p]· Enemy AI now recognizes type changes from Ocean, and knows it can stop Ocean with Time-stop or Positive.[/p][p]· Now if opponent fails Spy, AI will slam its worst card and win by default.[/p][p]· Enemy AI now knows that guns with Time-stop gain advantage over other cards.[/p][p]· Enemy AI now sees face-up Devour cards, and will play its worst card in it. [i](Before enemy AI was just dumb, and allowed you you to eat its gun with Stallion or Tree Goblin.)[/i][/p][p]
[/p][p][u]Music[/u][/p][p][i]Added 2 new songs.[/i][/p][p]· Mission [i]– [/i]This is new Church Gathering type rap song. [i](New theme for the Sisters.)[/i][/p][p]· Agentti – This was a quirky song I made on my own. I will try to make more of my own music in the future. [i](Also changed Rauta Nousee and En Ikin Kuole from the last update with my own versions.)[/i][/p][p]
[/p][p][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/p][p][i]Fixed annoying bugs.[/i][/p][p]· Fixed bug that if started new game while stopping time, then the game stayed slow and no music played until next time stop card was played.[/p][p]· Fixed a bug with Devow that it did not keep its own stamp and holographic if the card eaten did not have any.[/p][p]· Fixed a bug that if card had two spy type effects, they did not trigger in chain but tried to trigger at same time, and that was very buggy.[/p][p]
[/p][p][u]Visuals[/u][/p][p][i]Small quality-of-life changes.[/i][/p][p]· Gave a better trolling sprite for Agent 47. [i](The old troll sprite was more like another character. This one looks more swag and serious.)[/i][/p][p][i]· [/i]New sprites for Anne-Lotte’s Ant Queen -variant. [i](That is a new rare opponent. She uses Champion and Divine cards in tandem with the default Kawaii cards she has. Also, the Badass -variant for Farty-Pete is now enabled. He uses Delusional and Demonic cards.)[/i][/p][p][i]· [/i]Each opponent can now have more than 1 possible background. [i](Added second background to some opponents.)[/i][/p][p]· Dealt with foil inflation. [i](There was too many kinda bad cards with foil treatment. I made 3 before foil card non-foil to make it feel special again.)[/i][/p][p]· Between-game-background-cards now spawn in bursts. [i](Looks more satisfying. Also, made so that 1 tenth of time, Undead and Tidal cards will show as guns.)[/i][/p][p]· Losing points makes negative point poppets float up from your point counter.[/p][p]
[/p][p][u]SFX[/u][/p][p][i]Game has become more immersive.[/i][/p][p]· Rattlesnake rattle and hiss sound effect for Victim. [i](Really makes you scared.)[/i][/p][p]· Bongo drums and alien gun sound for Luv Luv Slaver. [i](He joins the tribe!)[/i][/p][p]· Bow shooting and rubber reload sound for Fire Arrows. [i](Really enjoying this one. I need to add more sound effects for common cards. Just so much more satisfying. I feel like I want to pick this card just because of the sound. Fire Arrows is also a good common though.)[/i][/p][p]· Missile turret sound effect for Drone. [i](Quick destruction, as it shoots more bullets than any other gun.)[/i][/p][p]· Piano glissando sound for spying. [i](The spy sound effect for previous version is now for Dirt.)[/i][/p][p]· Added alien beep sound, like spawning a card from nothing, for Berserk.[/p][p]· Added a low rumble sound for Shadow-replace. [i](Now it really feels like Renderer spawns from a shadow.)[/i][/p][p]· Wet sounds added for Clone and Contagious. The perfect versions have heavenly choir added in addition. [i](Also made so the Ocean Dweller shine effect is shown when a card gets cloned or altered.)[/i][/p][p]· Creepy girl laughing for Ticci Doll.[/p][p]
[/p][p]~~~[/p][p]That is all new in v0.9. I also added the Settings button, but not the settings yet – heheh! I have to figure what kind of settings the game needs. There’s been comments on being able to change music volume or disabling window shake. [i](What I like most is adding new cards, sound effects and animations. So, the settings has not been a priority.)[/i][/p][p]The game will be changed to paid 1st of October, and will be priced at $7.99 USD. [i](Based on the comments, that is what people thought was a fair price for the game.)[/i][/p][p]Thank you, see you again in November. I read all the comments, so hit me if you have anything to ask. Love you, bye![/p][p][/p][p]Eero Laine[/p]

notes.title: September 2025 Update
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Version 0.8 brings the players a small selection of new cards and mechanics. New immersive sound effects have been added. Some old music tracks have also been retired and replaced. There is a bunch of small game logic changes and UI improvements. [i](Next version 0.9 will be released after one month, 3rd of October.)[/i][/p][p]
[/p][p][u]Keywords[/u][/p][p][i]5 new keywords have been added.[/i][/p][p]· Skibbidy – [i]Double multiplier for each card in your hand.[/i][/p][p]· Hivemind – [i]If an effect would affect a card in hand, it affects all the cards in the hand instead.[/i][/p][p]· Devow – [i]Permanently eats the first card opponent plays, and becomes a negative copy of it.[/i][/p][p]· Buried Alive –[i] Played face-down. Becomes a random card of the same type, gains the other keywords.[/i][/p][p]· Coin-flip –[i] 50% chance to get double multiplier and repeat.[/i][/p][p]
[/p][p][u]Cards[/u][/p][p][i]13 new cards have been added.[/i][/p][p]· Snuff King’s Hat [i](Paper)[/i] – Skibbidy[/p][p]· Harmonica [i](Rockstar)[/i] – Skibbidy[/p][p]· Tent-Launcher [i](Gun)[/i] – Skibbidy, Wrapped[/p][p]· Combat Boots [i](Rock)[/i] – Brotherhood, Skibbidy[/p][p]· Alien Brain [i](Rock)[/i] – Hivemind[/p][p]· Grooming Scissors [i](Scissor)[/i] – Horse-gear[/p][p]· Elder Mimic [i](Mimic)[/i] – Buried, Devow[/p][p]· Unidentified Egg [i](Bedrock)[/i] – Hivemind, Sabotage[/p][p]· Spikes [i](Scissor)[/i] – Buried Alive, Rust[/p][p]· Eternal Pyre [i](Mimic)[/i] – Buried Alive, Pair[/p][p]· Papyrus [i](Paper)[/i] – Buried Alive, Cursed[/p][p]· Hoard [i](Rock)[/i] – Buried Alive, Coin-flip[/p][p]· Pachinko [i](Zipper)[/i] – Digital, Coin-flip[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663986/973a100cc64e2b1f9e921cf009d2c76520937f65.png"][/img][/p][p][u]Music[/u][/p][p][i]Four tracks has been retired and replaced by new songs.[/i][/p][p]· Beyond Redemption → Palaan Takaisin [i](The song is too long, and not enough bass to make it epic.)[/i][/p][p]· Making Grandma Proud → Suppa Star [i](Too relaxing, not epic at all. Makes me less hype.)[/i][/p][p]· Farty-Pete → Rauta Nousee [i](This and grandma song where the first songs created, and the lyrics are all over the place. This song specifically is too comedic and not epic at all.)[/i][/p][p]· Kissatyttö → En Ikin Kuole [i](Song is too explicit, and does not sound epic. Not enough bass or anything catchy.)[/i][/p][p]I’ve personally started to hate the four retired tracks. The new songs are super epic, and overall have better lyrics and a lot of bass.[/p][p]
[/p][p][u]SFX[/u][/p][p][i]New sound effects to make game feel more responsive, and the flow more immersive.[/i][/p][p]· New vacuum sound effect for shooting a tent with [i]Tent-Launcher[/i].[/p][p]· New diamond cracking sound effect for shooting with [i]Amethyst[/i]. [i](Cannot believe I forgot to add a shooting animation for this card – it is one of my favorites. Just shows to show how often I tend to hit Tidal with Amethyst.)[/i][/p][p][i]· [/i]Cyberpunk sounding sound effect when shooting with [i]Unidentified Egg[/i].[/p][p]· Kazoo sound effect when [i]spying[/i]. [i](Sounds fun, currently same for Dirt and Berserk.)[/i][/p][p]· Futuristic sound effect for [i]Digital[/i]. [i](Really makes the effect feel more powerful.)[/i][/p][p]· Coin flip success and failure have their own sound effects. [i](When winning, shining coins go up equal to wins. When losing, a single small coin falls down.)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663986/3c4d780d8ab3aa5da58d3388029d20ad9982d240.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][u]Logic changes[/u][/p][p][i]Some keyword and state interactions have been changed.[/i][/p][p]· Keyword Secrets now also loses to Spy while on the field. [i](Before only affected if the card with Secrets was spied from hand.)[/i][/p][p][i]· [/i]If both cards have a negative multiplier, it is automatically a tie. [i](Before two negatives meant the negative multipliers where both treated as positive, but that is too complicated. Easier that negative always means lose.)[/i][/p][p][i]· [/i]Multiplier is now hidden for face-down cards. [i](Before testing Tent-Launcher, did not know I had missed this.)[/i][/p][p][i]· [/i]Rainbow can no longer turn the card into the same card it already was, so now always changes the card to a different one.[/p][p]· Fixed bug, that when going second and you play a buried card that stops the time, and then play a buried card into it – the buried card was not flipped face-up after time-stop. [i](Basically I changed that when time is stopped, it resets the end of turn steps, so now nutting for example also always triggers even after time stop. Also, note that with Buried + Time-stop + Some keyword that draws, this could make an infinite combo. So I hard-coded that time can only be stopped max 10 times a round. Also Positive and Ocean can now trigger when revealed from buried, and they too reset the end of round procedures.)[/i][/p][p][i]· [/i]Card’s multiplier now also affects points opponent gains from defeating it. [i](Originally multiplier was just used for time-stop gun advantage and Snuff King. But now as it has become a very generic thing, is it made to work the same as Champion’s multiplier. Note that Holographic and Rare Stamp still do not increase points opponent gains from defeating the cards, as those are the premium upgrades.)[/i][/p][p]
[/p][p][u]UI changes[/u][/p][p][i]Small UI improvements to improve the game experience.[/i][/p][p]· Reversed positive and negative multiplier bar colors. [i](Positive is now red, negative is now blue. I feel red is more powerful color, so it needs to be the positive one. Also, used more often. Negative multiplier can only be given with Dirt, for now.)[/i][/p][p][i]· Streamer Rock[/i] and [i]Divorce Petition[/i] had the corners of their art cut.[i] (Only realized when making the card gallery, that I had forgot to cut the corners for these two old cards.)[/i][/p][p]· New purple cross particle effect for sabotage, and repeated-knife-slash sound effect with it. [i](I wanted this effect to look epic with the aliens and also work with the common sabotage cards.)[/i][/p][p]
[/p][p][u]Card pool changes[/u][/p][p][i]New cards added, some cards switched their house.[/i][/p][p]· New card pool, [b]Divine[/b], added. The new opponent [b]Sisters[/b] uses it and [i]Kawaii[/i].[/p][p]· Stopwatch moved from [i]Hightech[/i] → [i]Champion[/i] [i](I wanted to reduce entropy so only Champion, Delusional and Demonic have access to the keyword Time-stop.)[/i][/p][p][i]· [/i]Holy Bible moved from [i]Champion[/i] → [i]Divine[/i] [i](Just makes sense that Divine house has the Divine keyword – daa.)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663986/937f7fe419c9ab07596cfa79feb77870135b984e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][u]External tools[/u][/p][p][/p][p]Added card gallery to the website: [url="https://www.rakuel.com/hardest/card-gallery"]https://www.rakuel.com/hardest/card-gallery[/url] .[/p][p][/p][p]· My website now has a card gallery to get the high quality images of the cards. [i](You can filter to find all possible cards and keywords in the game for any category. New cards will be added to the gallery with each version release.)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663986/390ba491eec9ca10769abb189571af4e378de97a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663986/595fd9df7dd7bb07c52081d20b2d64aff5094c0d.png"][/img][/p][p]~~~[/p][p]That is everything new in September. If you have any questions, write them down. I read all the comments. See you again next month.[/p]

notes.title: Hardest will become a Paid Game!
notes.content: [p]I have three points. First the problems releasing on mobile, second is what immediately happens now that focus is only on the Steam release. Third is the future plans for the game.[/p][p][/p][p]I have tried to get the game released on Google Play. There is 3 major problems with the platform. First is there is a new requirement that the game has to be tested by 12 players on 14 consecutive days. The problems is not with getting testers, its about requirement of the 14 consecutive days. Basically the minimum 12 players have to all open the app daily during the two weeks, and that is no-way developer friendly. I have found some people on the internet and had friends play the came for couple hours and give critical feedback. It's very good to improve the quality of the product. But there is nothing gained for having anyone open and play the game every day of the week, and I feel that is a very Nazi thing to ask anyone. It seems like a way Google is just misusing their monopoly power. This requirement is only for new accounts though. I had my old Google Play developer account, but past two years I was just studying in the university, and happened they had terminated my account for inactivity for not releasing anything for 36 months during that time. And the repel time has also concluded.[/p][p]~~~[/p][p]Second problem with Google Play is they demand constant updates to versions anytime the API changes, and will terminate the application in 30 days if not updated. As a single hobbyist developer I don't constantly check the release dashboards – I will not know in 30 days of any of these changes. I have life outside developing these games. Also, I feel miserable thinking that if I fall ill or die, they will just erase the game and my legacy in couple months and not even know my game ever existed. On Steam I expect it will be at least like ten years before they delete my game.[/p][p]~~~[/p][p]Third is that Google does not have any features for single developers to gain visibility for the game. Google Play has no New Games -page, and even searching the game with right filters might not show my game. Basically if you don't get the direct link to the game from somewhere else, you cannot find the game. On Steam I can just put "hardest" on the search bar, and my game will come first.[/p][p][/p][p]So now immediate changes will be that anyone rolled in the Google Play closed demo will lose ability to get any new updates. From now on, the game is only distributed for PC through Steam. I will still develop the game to be mobile compatible, for my own personal use. Also, I like to physically demo the game on mobile devices anywhere. Mobile gaming is so convenient – sad the same cannot be said for the mobile app stores :([/p][p]~~~[/p][p]At the end of August, the game will be changed from free-to-play to a paid game. Anyone who currently has added the game to their Steam library, will continue to have access to their copy and is not required to pay anything. I'll do this because plan was to add micro transactions to the mobile release, but that is not possible any longer. Steam users do not like micro transactions, but like purchasing games, especially during Steam Sales. Steam also promotes free apps less. I will price the game around 25 USD. Pricing the game on the high-end is morally superior because it benefits the whole ecosystem. Expensive games promote other developers also to be paid reasonably for their work. Also, I believe the early players will be happy for basically getting a premium-priced roguelike for free.[/p][p][/p][p]For the future of the game, starting from September, I will be releasing monthly updates for the game. These updates will be small in scope, and will include variety of different fixes and improvements. For content, you can expect a monthly update to include in average 5 new cards, 1 new keyword and some sound effects. I consider the game already finished, and worth the 25 USD. These updates are more for my own amusement, and having something to tinker with. They will not majorly change the current game and experience. Monthly updates will last for the next 10 months.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you, I will answer if you have any questions – Eero Laine[/p]
